unassigned_money.fail: Committed money is not assigned to any cost line.
unassigned_money.suggestion: Link the contract or order lines to cost lines so the money shows in the right place.

certified_over_committed.fail: Certified work exceeds the award plus approved changes.
certified_over_committed.suggestion: Approve the change that covers the extra work, or check the claim.

forecast_over_plan.fail: The forecast is above the planned amount.
forecast_over_plan.suggestion: Check the source of the forecast; record a manual forecast with a reason if you expect savings.

partly_awarded.fail: Only part of the planned amount is awarded; the forecast may be missing work still to let.
partly_awarded.suggestion: If more work is still to be let on this line, enter a manual forecast.

pending_changes.fail: Change orders are waiting for a decision.
pending_changes.suggestion: Decide the pending change orders; the forecast does not include them yet.

snapshot_stale.fail: No forecast has been saved for more than a month.
snapshot_stale.suggestion: Save a forecast snapshot so the cost history stays readable.

account_code_duplicate.fail: Account code {code} appears more than once in the cost structure.
account_code_duplicate.suggestion: Keep one account per code and move its cost lines onto it.

mixed_standard.fail: The cost structure mixes code lists: {standards}.
mixed_standard.suggestion: Build the structure from one code list; map the other codes onto it.

account_parent_cycle.fail: Account {code} is its own ancestor through {count} accounts.
account_parent_cycle.suggestion: Give one of these accounts a parent outside the loop.

account_too_deep.fail: Account {code} sits on level {level}, deeper than the {max} levels of its code list.
account_too_deep.suggestion: Attach the account to a parent within the code list's depth.

no_account.fail: {count} cost lines worth {amount} are on no account (first: {code}).
no_account.suggestion: Give these positions a code of the structure's code list, or assign the cost lines to an account.

invalid_account.fail: {count} cost lines worth {amount} are on a closed account or one that takes no postings (first: {code}).
invalid_account.suggestion: Move the cost lines to an open account that takes postings.

own_amount_on_parent.fail: Account {code} has sub-accounts and also its own amount of {amount}.
own_amount_on_parent.suggestion: Move the own amount to a sub-account, or keep it as a deliberate allowance.

rollup_mismatch.fail: The structure total {reported} differs from its parts {expected} by {difference}.
rollup_mismatch.suggestion: Reload the structure; if the gap stays, check accounts whose parent is missing.

allocation_incomplete.fail: The shares of position {ordinal} add up to {total}{unit} instead of {expected}{unit}.
allocation_incomplete.suggestion: Adjust the shares so the whole position is allocated, no more and no less.

allocation_mixed_modes.fail: Position {ordinal} is split partly by percent and partly by quantity.
allocation_mixed_modes.suggestion: Split the position in one way only.

vector_not_inherited.fail: Contract line {code} sits on a cost line its bill position is not allocated to.
vector_not_inherited.suggestion: Put the line back on the position's cost lines, or record the override with a reason.

contingency_not_on_profit.fail: Contingency "{markup}" is computed on a base that already carries the profit line "{profit}", so a margin is charged on money set aside for risk
contingency_not_on_profit.suggestion: Apply this line to the direct cost, unless the market's standard method deliberately places risk after overhead and profit

order_is_declared.fail: Place {order} in the order is claimed by more than one markup line: {markups}
order_is_declared.suggestion: Give each markup line its own place, so what compounds onto what is not left to chance

percentage_within_band.fail: "{markup}" is {percentage}% as a {category} line, outside the plausible band of 0 to {ceiling}%
percentage_within_band.suggestion: Check the decimal point. The line is priced exactly as entered either way

cumulative_base_is_settled.fail: "{markup}" applies to "{apply_to}" but nothing precedes it, so it computes on the direct cost alone
cumulative_base_is_settled.suggestion: Move it after the lines it should compound onto, or apply it to the direct cost

hours_per_day_max.fail: Worker {worker} is booked {hours} h on this day, over the {max} h limit
hours_per_day_max.suggestion: Split the hours onto the correct day or worker before submitting

line_complete.labour_xor_plant: must book either labour or plant, not both or neither
line_complete.hours_positive: hours must be greater than zero
line_complete.suggestion: Complete the line before submitting the timesheet

cost_code_resolves.fail: Line {line} code '{code}' matches no BOQ position or WBS in this project
cost_code_resolves.suggestion: Pick a cost code or WBS that exists in the project BOQ

daywork_needs_variation.fail: Daywork line {line} is not linked to an open variation
daywork_needs_variation.suggestion: Link the daywork to the variation it was instructed under

plant_needs_equipment.fail: Plant line {line} names no equipment item
plant_needs_equipment.suggestion: Attach the machine so plant hours can be costed

approved_immutable.fail: This timesheet is {status} and cannot be edited
approved_immutable.suggestion: Post a reversing timesheet to correct approved hours

offline_clock_plausible.fail: The device that recorded this day was {minutes} minutes ahead of the server clock
offline_clock_plausible.suggestion: Set the device clock so recorded times can be read in the right order

offline_sync_delay.fail: This day was worked on {date} and only reached the office {days} days later
offline_sync_delay.suggestion: Check the hours against the day itself before approving, the valuation may already be closed

outdoor_heat_ban.fail: Line {line} records work from {start} to {end} on {date}, inside the midday outdoor work ban from {ban_from} to {ban_to}
outdoor_heat_ban.suggestion: If this work was outdoors in direct sun, move it out of the ban hours; indoor work and exempt sectors are not affected

unreviewed_proposals.fail: {count} takeoff proposals are still awaiting review and are not priced here
unreviewed_proposals.suggestion: Work through the review queue so the confirmed quantities match the drawing

position_has_quantity.fail: Position {ordinal} must not have zero or missing quantity

position_has_unit_rate.fail: Position {ordinal} should have a unit rate assigned
position_has_unit_rate.suggestion: Assign a rate from the cost database

position_has_description.fail: Position {ordinal} cannot have an empty description

unit_rate_in_range.suggestion: Verify this unit rate - it's unusually high

negative_values.suggestion: Correct negative values - use positive numbers

unrealistic_rate.suggestion: Verify this value - it seems unrealistically high
unrealistic_rate.not_assessed_no_currency: {count} position(s) not assessed: the bill states no currency, so the money thresholds (written in {reference}) could not be scaled to it
unrealistic_rate.not_assessed_no_currency_suggestion: Set the project currency, or record a currency on the positions
unrealistic_rate.not_assessed_no_rate: {count} position(s) in {currency} not assessed: no {reference} to {currency} rate is on file, so the money thresholds could not be scaled to this bill
unrealistic_rate.not_assessed_no_rate_suggestion: Add a {reference} rate for {currency} to the FX rate register or to the project's exchange rates

resource_split_mismatch.fail: Position {ordinal}: resource subtotal {subtotal} differs from unit rate {rate} by {diff}
resource_split_mismatch.suggestion: Review the resource quantities and rates - their per-unit sum should match the position unit rate

empty_unit.fail: Position {ordinal} has empty or missing unit
empty_unit.suggestion: Assign a measurement unit (m, m2, m3, kg, pcs, lsum, etc.)

section_without_items.suggestion: Add positions under this section or remove the empty section

rate_vs_benchmark.fail: Position {ordinal}: unit rate {rate}/{unit} exceeds benchmark threshold {threshold}/{unit} - potentially unrealistic
rate_vs_benchmark.suggestion: Verify this rate - typical rates for {unit} should be below {threshold}. Check for unit or decimal errors.
rate_vs_benchmark.not_assessed_no_currency: {count} position(s) not assessed: the bill states no currency, so the benchmark thresholds (written in {reference}) could not be scaled to it
rate_vs_benchmark.not_assessed_no_currency_suggestion: Set the project currency, or record a currency on the positions
rate_vs_benchmark.not_assessed_no_rate: {count} position(s) in {currency} not assessed: no {reference} to {currency} rate is on file, so the benchmark thresholds could not be scaled to this bill
rate_vs_benchmark.not_assessed_no_rate_suggestion: Add a {reference} rate for {currency} to the FX rate register or to the project's exchange rates

lump_sum_ratio.fail: {lsum_count} of {total_count} positions ({percent}) use lump sum - exceeds {threshold} threshold
lump_sum_ratio.suggestion: Break down lump sum positions into measured quantities (m, m2, m3, kg, pcs) for better estimation accuracy

cost_concentration.fail: Position {ordinal} accounts for {share} of total BOQ cost ({value} of {grand_total}) - exceeds {threshold} threshold
cost_concentration.suggestion: Break this position into smaller items or verify the cost - a single position should not dominate the estimate

currency_consistency.suggestion: Use a single currency throughout the BOQ

measurement_consistency.fail: BOQ mixes metric and imperial units - use one system consistently
measurement_consistency.suggestion: Convert all quantities to either metric or imperial units

revision_cost_impact_review.fail: Revision cost impact of {amount} is not yet captured as a variation
revision_cost_impact_review.suggestion: Create a draft variation request from this revision compare to track the cost change

base_date_readable.fail: Base date '{base_date}' is not a date, so the bill is taxed at today's rate rather than its own
base_date_readable.suggestion: State the price base as a day, a month, a quarter or a year ({shapes})

tax_date_readable.fail: Tax date '{tax_date}' is not a date, so the bill is taxed at today's rate rather than its own
tax_date_readable.suggestion: State the tax date as a day, a month, a quarter or a year ({shapes}), or clear it to tax the bill on its base date

cost_group_required.suggestion: Assign a 3-digit DIN 276 Kostengruppe (e.g., 330 for walls)

hierarchy.fail: Position {ordinal}: KG {child} is not under parent KG {parent} (expected prefix '{prefix}')
hierarchy.suggestion: Move position to correct parent or update KG code to match parent hierarchy ({prefix}xx)

completeness.fail: KG group {group} - {group_name} is missing from BOQ
completeness.suggestion: Add positions for KG {group} ({group_name}) to ensure complete coverage

ordinal_format.fail: Ordinal '{ordinal}' does not match the GAEB OZ-Maske of this file
ordinal_format.suggestion: Use the file's OZ-Maske, e.g. 001.001.0010 or 01.02.0030

lv_structure.fail: Position {ordinal}: leaf position has no parent section - GAEB LV hierarchy requires a Leistungsgruppe parent
lv_structure.suggestion: Assign this position to a parent section (Leistungsgruppe / Titel)

einheitspreis_sanity.negative: Position {ordinal}: Einheitspreis {rate} is negative (unit='{unit}') - a negative price cannot be transferred in GAEB
einheitspreis_sanity.zero: Position {ordinal}: Einheitspreis is 0.00 (unit='{unit}') - confirm this is an offered zero price and not a missing rate
einheitspreis_sanity.suggestion: Provide a positive Einheitspreis, or mark the position as a Bedarfsposition (optional scope) or lump sum (unit='lsum')

trade_section_code.fail: Top-level section '{ordinal}' has no GAEB Leistungsbereich code (expected 3-digit trade code, e.g. '012')
trade_section_code.suggestion: Add a 3-digit trade code (Leistungsbereich) to the section - e.g. '012' for Erdarbeiten, '013' for Mauerarbeiten

quantity_decimals.fail: Position {ordinal}: quantity {quantity} has {decimals} decimal places - GAEB X83 convention limits to 3
quantity_decimals.suggestion: Round the quantity to at most 3 decimal places per GAEB X83

classification_required.suggestion: Assign an NRM 1/2 element code (e.g., 2.6.1 for external walls)

base_date_declared.fail: The cost plan does not state the base date its rates are current at
base_date_declared.suggestion: Record the base date on the bill. Without it nobody can say whether a rate is stale or what inflation still has to be added

cost_plan_stage_declared.fail: The cost plan does not say which design stage it was produced for
cost_plan_stage_declared.suggestion: Record the stage. The accuracy a reader may expect of a cost plan is set by the stage it was produced at, and a plan that hides its stage invites the wrong expectation

contractor_costs_present.preliminaries: The cost plan carries no main contractor's preliminaries, neither as group {group} nor as a markup line
contractor_costs_present.overheads_and_profit: The cost plan carries no main contractor's overheads and profit, neither as group {group} nor as a markup line
contractor_costs_present.suggestion: Add it as an NRM group element or as a markup line on the measured work. Either is correct; leaving it out means the works cost is not the works cost

risk_allowance_present.fail: The cost plan carries no risk allowance
risk_allowance_present.suggestion: Add a risk allowance as NRM group 13 or as a contingency line. A cost plan with no risk allowance is presenting a single-point figure as if it were certain

classification_required.suggestion: Assign a MasterFormat code (e.g., 03 30 00 for cast-in-place concrete work)

valid_division.suggestion: Use 6-digit MasterFormat format: XX XX XX (e.g., 03 30 00)

code_required.suggestion: Assign a SINAPI composition code (e.g., 87878 for concrete C30)

classification_required.suggestion: Tag the position with an NBR 12721 section (S1 = preliminares, S2 = infra-estrutura, ..., S11 = serviços complementares)

valid_section.fail: NBR 12721 section '{code}' in position {ordinal} is not one of S1..S11
valid_section.suggestion: Use codes S1 through S11 (e.g., S3 for supra-estrutura)

code_required.suggestion: Assign a ГЭСН code (e.g., 06-01-001-01 for concrete)

valid_code.fail: ГЭСН code '{code}' doesn't match format XX-XX-XXX-XX

resource_breakdown.fail: Position {ordinal} cites norm {code} but carries no resource breakdown
resource_breakdown.suggestion: Import the norm's labour, plant and material quantities, or state why this line deviates from them

labour_hours_present.fail: Position {ordinal} ({code}) has a resource breakdown with no labour hours
labour_hours_present.suggestion: Add the man-hours the norm consumes; overhead and estimated profit are normed on payroll and cannot be computed without them

price_level_declared.fail: The estimate does not say which price level its figures are in
price_level_declared.suggestion: Declare the price level (a date) and the conversion index applied, so a reviewer can reach the same total

lot_required.fail: Position {ordinal} not assigned to any Lot technique
lot_required.suggestion: Assign a Lot technique (e.g., Lot 01 Gros Œuvre)

pricing_complete.fail: Only {priced}/{total} positions ({percent}) have pricing - below 80% threshold
pricing_complete.suggestion: Complete pricing for all positions before DPGF submission

position_format.fail: Ordinal '{ordinal}' doesn't match ÖNORM format XX.XX.XXXXA

description_length.fail: Position {ordinal}: description too short ({length} chars, min 20)
description_length.suggestion: Add more detail to the position description per ÖNORM B 2063

valid_code.fail: Invalid GB/T 50500 code '{code}' - expected 9 or 12 digits

code_required.suggestion: Assign a CPWD DSR item reference (e.g., 4.1.1)

measurement_units.fail: Unit '{unit}' in position {ordinal} not standard IS 1200
measurement_units.suggestion: Use standard IS 1200 units: m, m2, m3, kg, nos, rm, etc.

item_code_required.fail: Position {ordinal} carries no Hungarian item code
item_code_required.invalid: Item code '{code}' on position {ordinal} matches neither item order
item_code_required.suggestion: Building works use MA-CC-SS-II (chapter 01 to 17), infrastructure works use the six or seven digit item number from the project code dictionary

chapter_recognised.fail: Chapter {chapter} on position {ordinal} is not one of the seventeen in the item order

material_fee_split.fail: Position {ordinal}: material {material} plus fee {fee} does not add up to the rate {rate}
material_fee_split.suggestion: Correct the material and fee unit prices, or the rate, so the split reconciles

item_number_unique.fail: Item number {number} is used on {count} positions and has to identify one
item_number_unique.suggestion: Give each position its own project item number before the bill leaves for the client

voce_code_format_valid.fail: Code '{code}' on position {ordinal} does not show which price list it comes from
voce_code_format_valid.suggestion: An official voce code starts with the region and the edition year of its price list, for example TOS25_01.A03.001.001 (Toscana 2025). Copy the code exactly as the regional list prints it, import the line from the list, or number a new price NP.01

voce_reference_present.suggestion: Pick the line from an imported regional price list, or mark it as a nuovo prezzo (NP) backed by a price analysis

costi_sicurezza_separated.fail: The bill carries no separate line for the safety costs not subject to the tender discount
costi_sicurezza_separated.suggestion: Add the oneri della sicurezza as their own section or markup line, priced from the safety chapter of the price list or the safety plan

incidenza_manodopera_documented.fail: Position {ordinal} ({code}) does not state its labour share
incidenza_manodopera_documented.suggestion: Take the incidenza della manodopera from the price list, or add a labour resource, so the labour cost can be stated separately in the tender

overheads_not_applied_twice.fail: Regional price-list rates already include general expenses (13-17%) and profit (10%). Applying them again raises the total by about {percent}%.
overheads_not_applied_twice.suggestion: Remove the general expenses and profit markups from this bill, or keep them only on lines priced by your own analysis (NP).

deviz_chapter_required.fail: Position {ordinal} names no deviz general chapter
deviz_chapter_required.suggestion: File the line under its HG 907/2016 chapter and subchapter, for example 4.1 for construction and installation works or 5.1 for site organisation

deviz_chapter_recognised.fail: Deviz code '{code}' on position {ordinal} is not a chapter or subchapter of the deviz general
deviz_chapter_recognised.suggestion: Use a code from chapters 1 to 6 of the HG 907/2016 deviz general, such as 1.2, 2, 3.5, 4.1, 5.1 or 6.2

net_article_required.fail: Position {ordinal} carries no unified price list (ΝΕΤ) article
net_article_required.suggestion: Name the ΝΕΤ article the line is priced from, for example ΟΙΚ 32.01.06, or ΝΑΟΙΚ for a new article

net_article_valid.invalid: Article '{code}' on position {ordinal} does not have the shape of a ΝΕΤ article
net_article_valid.chapter: Article '{code}' on position {ordinal} opens chapter {chapter}, which the building-works price list does not have
net_article_valid.suggestion: Write the list prefix and the article number, for example ΟΙΚ 38.20.02, ΟΔΟ Α-2 or ΑΤΗΕ 8151.1

zkr_chapter_required.fail: Position {ordinal} names no chapter of the summary estimate
zkr_chapter_required.suggestion: File the line under its chapter of the зведений кошторисний розрахунок, 1 to 12; building works of the main object sit in chapter 2

zkr_chapter_recognised.fail: Chapter {chapter} on position {ordinal} is not one of the twelve chapters of the summary estimate
zkr_chapter_recognised.suggestion: Use a chapter number from 1 to 12

code_required.fail: Position {ordinal} missing birim fiyat poz number
code_required.suggestion: Assign the poz number from the unit-price list (e.g. 15.150.1005), or number your own analysed item ÖZEL-1

valid_poz.fail: Poz '{code}' is neither a current unit-price book number (XX.XXX.XXXX) nor an older one (XX.XXX/X)
valid_poz.suggestion: Use the book's number, e.g. 15.150.1005, or 04.013/1 on an older contract; number your own analysed items as ÖZEL-1

chapter_recognised.fail: Poz '{code}' on position {ordinal} starts with {chapter}, which is not a chapter of a unit-price list this check knows
chapter_recognised.suggestion: The Ministry book numbers building works 15, mechanical installation 25 and electrical installation 35, with resource prices under 10 and plant analyses under 19. Check the number against the list it was taken from, or number your own item ÖZEL-1

unit_recognised.fail: Unit '{unit}' on position {ordinal} is not one the unit-price lists measure in
unit_recognised.suggestion: Use the unit the list gives for the item, for example m, m², m³, Ad, Tk, Kg, Ton, Sa

poz_unit_consistent.fail: Poz '{code}' is measured in {count} different units in this bill ({units})
poz_unit_consistent.suggestion: A poz number is defined in one unit. Bring the lines to the unit the list gives, or give the differing work its own number

poz_rate_consistent.fail: Poz '{code}' is priced at {count} different unit rates in this bill ({rates})
poz_rate_consistent.suggestion: One poz number has one unit price in a bill. Use one rate, or number the differing item separately as an own item

own_item_analysed.fail: Own item '{code}' on position {ordinal} carries no price analysis
own_item_analysed.suggestion: An item the list does not have is priced by its own analysis. Add the labour, material and plant resources under the line, or write the analysis into its note

profit_overhead_once.fail: Contractor profit and general expenses are applied on {count} lines, {total} percent together, above the single {limit} percent
profit_overhead_once.suggestion: The 25 percent is added once. Keep one line, and remove it altogether when the rates are published unit prices, which already contain it

unit_matches_poz_definition.fail: Poz '{code}' on position {ordinal} is measured in '{unit}', but the installed unit-price book defines it in '{book_unit}'
unit_matches_poz_definition.suggestion: A poz number is defined in one unit. Measure the line in the book's unit, or number the differing work as your own item (ÖZEL-1)
unit_matches_poz_definition.not_installed: The national unit-price base ({region}) is not installed, so the units and rates of {count} poz numbers were not checked against the published book. Load it from the cost database import page
unit_matches_poz_definition.unavailable: The national unit-price base ({region}) could not be read, so the units and rates of {count} poz numbers were not checked against the published book

unit_rate_within_published_price.below: Poz '{code}' on position {ordinal}: rate {rate} is {percent} percent below the published price of {published} in the installed unit-price book
unit_rate_within_published_price.above: Poz '{code}' on position {ordinal}: rate {rate} is {percent} percent above the published price of {published} in the installed unit-price book
unit_rate_within_published_price.fail: That is more than the {limit} percent set for this check
unit_rate_within_published_price.suggestion: The comparison uses the unit-price base installed here, which does not record the year of its book. Published prices of the building, mechanical and electrical chapters already contain the {markup} percent contractor profit and general expenses. A rate below the published price is usual after a tender discount; check that the difference is intended
unit_rate_within_published_price.repriced: The national unit-price base ({region}) is switched to another market or currency, so rates were not compared with the published prices. Return the base to its home market to run this check
unit_rate_within_published_price.currency_differs: Rates on {count} lines are in {currency} while the unit-price book is in {book_currency}, so they were not compared with the published prices
unit_rate_within_published_price.currency_unknown: The currency of {count} lines is not recorded, so their rates were not compared with the published prices in {book_currency}

kdv_rate_in_force.fail: Tax line '{line}' charges KDV at {rate} percent, which is not a rate Turkish law sets; KDV is 20, 10 or 1 percent
kdv_rate_in_force.fail_superseded: Tax line '{line}' charges KDV at {rate} percent, a rate replaced on 10 July 2023; KDV is now 20, 10 or 1 percent
kdv_rate_in_force.suggestion: Set the KDV line to 20 percent, or to 10 or 1 percent where the supply qualifies, or to 0 for an exempt supply

code_required.suggestion: Assign a 積算基準 item code

metric_units.suggestion: Use standard metric units: m, m2, m3, kg, t, 式, etc.

code_required.suggestion: Assign a FIEBDC-3 code (e.g., E04CM040 or 01.02.01)

valid_code.suggestion: Use FIEBDC-3 alphanumeric format (e.g., E04CM040, 01.02.01, CAP01#)

apu_completeness.fail: Position {ordinal} has an incomplete APU; missing cost components: {missing}
apu_completeness.suggestion: Add the missing costo directo components (mano de obra, materiales, maquinaria) to the unit-price analysis

iva_rate_valid.fail: Position {ordinal} has an invalid IVA rate {rate}; Mexican IVA is 16, 8 (border region) or 0 percent
iva_rate_valid.suggestion: Set the IVA rate to 16 percent (standard), 8 percent (border region) or 0 percent

subcontract_retencion.fail: Subcontract position {ordinal} does not record whether IVA/ISR retenciones apply
subcontract_retencion.suggestion: Record the IVA and ISR retenciones for the subcontract line, or mark that none apply

cfdi_rfc_present.missing: CFDI issuer data is incomplete for tender export; missing: {missing}
cfdi_rfc_present.invalid_rfc: RFC '{rfc}' is not a valid CFDI RFC (12 characters for a company, 13 for an individual)
cfdi_rfc_present.suggestion: Set the issuer RFC, regimen fiscal and uso CFDI in the project profile for CFDI 4.0 invoicing

side_effecting_requires_gate.suggestion: Add a Validation gate or Human-approval gate on every path from a trigger/AI node to each write node before publishing.

escrow_account_required.fail: Development requires an active escrow account for regulator '{regulator}'
escrow_account_required.suggestion: Open an escrow account with the regulator-licensed bank under Compliance → Escrow accounts

escrow_iban_valid.fail: Escrow account {account}: IBAN '{iban}' fails ISO 13616 structural check
escrow_iban_valid.suggestion: Correct the IBAN: country code + length + checksum must match ISO 13616

escrow_balance_reconciled.fail: Escrow account {account}: ledger balance {ledger} drifts {drift} from {transactions} transactions sum
escrow_balance_reconciled.suggestion: Reconcile the escrow account - investigate unrecorded receipts or missing debits

sales_contract_party_ownership_sums_to_1.fail: Contract {contract}: ownership share sums to {total}% (must be exactly 100%)
sales_contract_party_ownership_sums_to_1.suggestion: Adjust party percentages so they total 100.00%

payment_schedule_instalments_sum_to_cont.fail: Contract {contract}: instalments total {instalments} differs from contract value {contract_value} (drift {drift})
payment_schedule_instalments_sum_to_cont.suggestion: Re-balance the payment schedule so instalment amounts add up to the contract total

reservation_expiry_in_future.fail: Reservation {reservation}: expires_at {expires} is not in the future
reservation_expiry_in_future.suggestion: Extend the reservation or transition it to expired/cancelled

broker_commission_rate_within_bounds.suggestion: Use a percent rate between 0.1% and 15%, a flat amount, or a non-empty ladder of tiers

price_matrix_no_negative_modifier.suggestion: Cap modifiers between -50% and +200% to avoid unrealistic plot prices

boq_coverage.fail: Position {ordinal} '{description}' ({amount}) is priced in the bill, but no activity carries it, so its cost is not in the schedule
boq_coverage.suggestion: Give the position a quantity or link it to an activity, then generate the schedule again.

cost_reconciliation.fail: The schedule carries {planned} of the bill's {bill}: {difference} of the priced work is on no activity
cost_reconciliation.suggestion: Check the positions the coverage check lists, then generate the schedule again.

duration_vs_norm.fail: Activity '{activity}' lasts {duration} working days, while its labour and machine norms give {norm}
duration_vs_norm.suggestion: Check the quantity, the crew and the norm hours of the position, or a duration that was changed by hand.

open_ends.fail: Activity '{activity}' has no {ends} logic (open end / dangling activity)
open_ends.suggestion: Tie the activity into the network with a predecessor and a successor link, or type it as a start/finish milestone

negative_lag.fail: Relationship {predecessor} -> {successor} uses negative lag ({lag} days), which is a lead and distorts the critical path
negative_lag.suggestion: Replace the lead with an explicit activity or an SS/FF relationship so the sequence stays defensible

excessive_lag.fail: Relationship {predecessor} -> {successor} has lag {lag} days, above the {threshold}-day threshold
excessive_lag.suggestion: Model the waiting time as its own activity (procurement, cure, approval) so it can carry status and be levelled

hard_constraints.fail: Activity '{activity}' has a hard date constraint ({constraint}) that overrides the network logic
hard_constraints.suggestion: Use a soft constraint (start-no-earlier-than) or drive the date through logic so the activity can move when predecessors slip

negative_float.fail: Activity '{activity}' has negative total float ({float} days), so the schedule is not achievable as logic-tied
negative_float.suggestion: Re-sequence the work, relax a hard constraint, or add a documented recovery plan to bring float back to zero or above

high_float.fail: Activity '{activity}' has very high total float ({float} days), above the {threshold}-day threshold
high_float.suggestion: Check for a missing successor link - high float usually means the activity is only loosely tied to the network

missing_duration.fail: Activity '{activity}' has an invalid duration ({duration} days) for a non-milestone task
missing_duration.suggestion: Set a positive working-day duration, or type the row as a milestone if it is genuinely a zero-duration event

duration_on_project_week.fail: Activity '{activity}' is stored as {stored} working days, the Monday-to-Friday count of {start} to {end}; on the project's week, {calendar}, those dates hold {expected}
duration_on_project_week.suggestion: Save the activity's dates again so the duration is recounted on the project's working week, or enter the duration deliberately

missing.fail: Sheet {sheet} is listed in the drawing index but is not in the uploaded set
missing.suggestion: Upload the missing sheet or confirm it was withdrawn from the issue

extra.fail: Sheet {sheet} is in the uploaded set but is not listed in the drawing index
extra.suggestion: Add it to the index or issue register, or remove the stray sheet

revision_mismatch.fail: Sheet {sheet} is at revision {actual_rev} but the index expects {expected_rev}
revision_mismatch.suggestion: Issue the expected revision or update the index to the current revision

po_has_lines.fail: This purchase order has no lines, so its committed amount is not accounted for
po_has_lines.suggestion: Add the ordered items before approving the purchase order

po_line_amount.fail: Line {line} totals {actual} but its quantity times unit rate is {expected}
po_line_amount.suggestion: Correct the quantity, the unit rate or the line amount so the three agree

po_subtotal_matches_lines.fail: The subtotal is {actual} but the lines add up to {expected}
po_subtotal_matches_lines.suggestion: Recalculate the subtotal from the current lines

po_total_matches_subtotal.fail: The total is {actual} but subtotal plus tax is {expected}
po_total_matches_subtotal.suggestion: Recalculate the total so it matches the subtotal plus the tax

po_no_negative_line.fail: Line {line} has a quantity that is not positive, or a negative unit rate
po_no_negative_line.suggestion: Raise a credit note for a reversal instead of a negative line

po_currency_set.fail: This purchase order has no currency, so its amount cannot be rolled up or paid
po_currency_set.suggestion: Set the currency, normally the one the project uses

po_vendor_assigned.fail: This purchase order names no vendor
po_vendor_assigned.suggestion: Select the vendor before approving the commitment

po_retention_within_bounds.fail: Retention of {percent}% is outside the plausible range of 0 to {max}%
po_retention_within_bounds.suggestion: Enter retention as a percentage, for example 5 for five percent

po_delivery_after_issue.fail: Delivery is set for {delivery}, before the issue date {issue}
po_delivery_after_issue.suggestion: Move the delivery date to the issue date or later

po_line_cost_coded.fail: Line {line} has no WBS, cost category or cost line, so it will not appear in the cost breakdown
po_line_cost_coded.suggestion: Assign a cost code so the commitment reports against a budget

invoice_within_order.fail: Invoice {invoice} is more than the {remaining} still open on order {po}, by {excess}
invoice_within_order.suggestion: Check the invoice against the order; if the extra was agreed, record it as a change to the order before approving

invoice_quantity_received.fail: Line {line} would be invoiced for {invoiced} in total, but only {received} has been received
invoice_quantity_received.suggestion: Wait for the delivery note or confirm the goods receipt before approving this quantity

invoice_value_received.fail: On order {po} the invoices would total {invoiced}, but the goods received are worth only {received} at the order rates
invoice_value_received.suggestion: Wait for the delivery note or confirm the goods receipt before approving this amount

requisition_quantity_positive.fail: Line {line} asks for {quantity}, but a requisition line needs a quantity above zero
requisition_quantity_positive.suggestion: Enter the quantity you need, or remove the line

requisition_source_unit.fail: Line {line} is in {unit} but one of its BOQ sources is in {source_unit}
requisition_source_unit.suggestion: Use the unit of the BOQ resource, or split the line so each unit stands on its own

requisition_needed_by_not_past.fail: The needed-by date {date} is already past (today is {today})
requisition_needed_by_not_past.suggestion: Set the date the material is actually needed on site

requisition_vendor_in_directory.fail: Supplier {vendor} is not in the Vendor directory
requisition_vendor_in_directory.suggestion: Choose the supplier from the Vendor directory

requisition_vendor_active.fail: Supplier {vendor} is not active in the Vendor directory, so nothing can be ordered from it
requisition_vendor_active.suggestion: Choose an active supplier, or reactivate this one in the Vendor directory first

requisition_vendor_chosen.fail: Requisition {req} names no supplier, and a purchase order needs one
requisition_vendor_chosen.suggestion: Choose the supplier from the Vendor directory before converting

requisition_single_currency.fail: Requisition {req} has lines priced in {currencies}, but one purchase order holds one currency
requisition_single_currency.suggestion: Price every line in one currency, or split the lines into separate requisitions

requisition_line_cost_line.fail: Line {line} is not linked to a cost line, so its order will not show as committed against the budget
requisition_line_cost_line.suggestion: Raise the line from the BOQ, or link it to a cost line before ordering

requisition_suggested_vendor_in_director.fail: Line {line} suggests supplier {vendor}, which is not in the Vendor directory
requisition_suggested_vendor_in_director.suggestion: Pick the suggested supplier from the Vendor directory, or clear the suggestion

requisition_suggested_vendor_active.fail: Line {line} suggests {vendor}, a supplier that is not active in the Vendor directory
requisition_suggested_vendor_active.suggestion: Suggest an active supplier, or leave the choice to the buyer

requisition_suggestion_conflict.fail: The BOQ sources of line {line} suggest {count} different suppliers
requisition_suggestion_conflict.suggestion: Pick one supplier for the line, or split it so each supplier gets its own line

requisition_suggested_vendor_differs.fail: Line {line} suggests {vendor}, but the requisition is to be ordered from another supplier
requisition_suggested_vendor_differs.suggestion: Check that the chosen supplier can deliver this line, or order it separately

requisition_line_needed_by_not_past.fail: Line {line} is needed by {date}, which is already past (today is {today})
requisition_line_needed_by_not_past.suggestion: Set the date the material is actually needed on site

requisition_line_schedule_moved.fail: Line {line} was planned for an activity starting {anchor}, but the activity now starts {start}
requisition_line_schedule_moved.suggestion: Check the needed-by date of the line against the current schedule and change it if needed

requisition_approver_not_requester.fail: The person who raised requisition {req} is also its designated approver number {step}
requisition_approver_not_requester.suggestion: Name a different approver for that step, so someone other than the requester decides

requisition_line_over_ordered.fail: Line {line} has {ordered} {unit} on orders, more than the {requested} {unit} requested
requisition_line_over_ordered.suggestion: Check whether the extra quantity is intended, or reduce the order line

requisition_order_unit_mismatch.fail: Order {order} holds line {line} in {unit}, which cannot be converted into the line's unit {line_unit}
requisition_order_unit_mismatch.suggestion: Correct the unit on the order line so its quantity counts as ordered

requisition_sources_reconcile.fail: Line {line} asks for {quantity} {unit}, but its BOQ sources add up to {sources} {unit}
requisition_sources_reconcile.suggestion: Set the quantity to the sum of its sources, or take out the sources the line does not cover

requisition_over_allocated.fail: Line {line} claims {excess} {unit} more than the BOQ needs ({demand} {unit} in all, {covered} {unit} already held by other requisitions)
requisition_over_allocated.suggestion: Reduce the quantity, or state a reason on the line if the extra is intended

receipt_certificate_present.fail: Line {line} was ordered with a {required}, but the delivery carries {delivered}
receipt_certificate_present.suggestion: Attach the certificate the order asks for, or reject the line until the supplier sends it

receipt_certificate_batch.fail: Certificate {certificate} on line {line} is for batch {certificate_batch}, but batch {batch} was delivered
receipt_certificate_batch.suggestion: Check the batch or heat number on the material and ask the supplier for the certificate of the batch that arrived

receipt_route_approved.fail: Goods receipt {receipt} on order {po} is routed for approval and not approved yet
receipt_route_approved.suggestion: Wait for the approval route of the goods receipt to finish before releasing the payment

receipt_inspection_closed.fail: The incoming inspection of goods receipt {receipt} on order {po} is not passed yet
receipt_inspection_closed.suggestion: Complete the inspection, or record why the material may be paid before it

agreement_has_scope.fail: This agreement has no work packages, so there is nothing for a payment application to claim against
agreement_has_scope.suggestion: Break the contracted scope into work packages before activating the agreement

package_scope_described.fail: Work package {package} has a name but no description of the work it covers
package_scope_described.suggestion: Write down what the package includes, so a later variation argument has a starting point

agreement_value_positive.fail: The contract value is {value}, so retention and the schedule of values have nothing to work from
agreement_value_positive.suggestion: Enter the agreed contract value before activating the agreement

packages_within_value.fail: The work packages are worth {planned} but the contract is {total}
packages_within_value.suggestion: Reprice the packages or raise the contract value so the agreement covers its own scope

agreement_dates_ordered.fail: The agreement ends on {end}, before it starts on {start}
agreement_dates_ordered.suggestion: Correct the start or end date so the contract period runs forwards

agreement_currency_set.fail: This agreement has no currency, so payments under it cannot be rolled up or paid
agreement_currency_set.suggestion: Set the currency, normally the one the project uses

retention_within_bounds.fail: Retention of {percent}% is outside the plausible range of 0 to {max}%
retention_within_bounds.suggestion: Enter retention as a percentage of each payment, not as an amount

insurance_valid_at_start.fail: The subcontractor's insurance expired on {expiry}, before work starts on {reference}
insurance_valid_at_start.suggestion: Collect a current certificate before letting the subcontractor on site

unlinked_contract_twin.fail: The subcontract {agreement} and the contract {contract} look like the same subcontract, so the finances may count it twice
unlinked_contract_twin.suggestion: Link them if they are the same subcontract, or mark them as different

contact_linked.fail: The contact person {contact} is not linked to the contacts directory, so the same person may be kept twice
contact_linked.suggestion: Add an email address to the contact person so it can be matched to the directory

reviewer_assigned.fail: This submittal names no reviewer, so it is submitted into nobody's court
reviewer_assigned.suggestion: Assign the reviewer who is to respond before submitting

required_date_present.fail: This submittal has no required date, so it can never be reported as late
required_date_present.suggestion: Set the date the review is needed by, driven by the work this submittal releases

required_date_after_submitted.fail: The review is due on {required}, before the submittal was filed on {submitted}
required_date_after_submitted.suggestion: Move the required date to a working date after submission

review_window_sufficient.fail: The reviewer has {days} days, less than the {minimum} days a review normally needs
review_window_sufficient.suggestion: Allow the customary review period, or agree the shorter one with the reviewer first

spec_section_present.fail: This submittal names no specification section, so the register cannot file it
spec_section_present.suggestion: Enter the specification section this submittal answers

approver_distinct_from_reviewer.fail: The same person ({person}) is both reviewer and approver, so there is no second pair of eyes
approver_distinct_from_reviewer.suggestion: Assign an approver other than the reviewer

linked_scope_present.fail: This submittal is linked to no scope item, so it never rolls up to a package
linked_scope_present.suggestion: Link the BOQ items this submittal covers

scope_described.fail: This request has no scope of work and no description, so there is nothing for a vendor to price
scope_described.suggestion: Describe the scope before publishing, so the bids you get back are comparable

deadline_present.fail: This request states no submission deadline, so bidding never closes
deadline_present.suggestion: Set the date and time by which bids must arrive

deadline_parseable.fail: The submission deadline {value} is not a date the system can read, and every bid will be refused
deadline_parseable.suggestion: Enter the deadline as a date, for example 2026-08-31

deadline_in_future.fail: The submission deadline {deadline} has already passed on {today}, so the request arrives closed
deadline_in_future.suggestion: Move the deadline to a future date before publishing

has_recipients.fail: This request is addressed to no vendor, so publishing it notifies nobody
has_recipients.suggestion: Add the vendors this request is going out to

currency_set.fail: This request states no currency, so the bids cannot be ranked against each other
currency_set.suggestion: Set the currency bids are to be priced in

bid_currency_matches.fail: Bid {bid} is priced in {bid_currency} but the request is in {rfq_currency}
bid_currency_matches.suggestion: Ask the bidder to requote in the request currency, or record the agreed conversion

bid_amounts_parseable.fail: Bid {bid} has an amount of {value}, which is not a number that can be ranked
bid_amounts_parseable.suggestion: Correct the bid amount before awarding

bids_still_valid.fail: Bid {bid} expired on {expired} and today is {today}, so its price is no longer binding
bids_still_valid.suggestion: Ask the bidder to confirm the price before awarding

award_has_competition.fail: This award rests on {count} bids, fewer than the {minimum} a competitive comparison needs
award_has_competition.suggestion: Record why a single-source award is justified, or invite more bidders

errors.documents_batch_delete_referenced: Records elsewhere still point at documents in this batch. Review what the delete severs and confirm with acknowledge_references.
errors.gaeb_x89_final_account_unsupported: A final account or part final account cannot be exported as GAEB X89 yet. It has to bill the cumulative work less earlier payments, and only a progress invoice of one period is built from a claim. Export the claim as a progress invoice.
errors.xpwe_native_file_refused: This is an estimating program's own project file, which only that program can open. Export the estimate as XPWE from your estimating program and upload the .xpwe file.
errors.xpwe_unreadable: This file cannot be read as XPWE. It may be damaged or of another type. Export the estimate as XPWE again and upload the .xpwe file.
errors.fx_rate_set_locked: The ECB rates for {date} are locked, so this refresh did not overwrite them. Unlock that rate set first if it should take the new publication.
errors.boq_locked: BOQ is locked and cannot be modified. Create a revision to make changes.
errors.boq_link_owner_locked: Code '{code}' is defined by a line in the locked bill '{bill}', and linking to it would change that bill. Unlock that bill first, or enter the line under a new code.

boq_lines_are_traced.fail: Line {line} in this variation's bill traces back to nothing - no schedule-of-values line and no estimating position
boq_lines_are_traced.suggestion: Name the contract line this change affects, or the estimate position the scope was taken from, so the figure can be defended

boq_total_matches_estimate.fail: The headline estimate on this request is {estimate}, but its priced bill totals {priced}
boq_total_matches_estimate.suggestion: Adopt the priced total onto the request, or correct the bill, so one figure is the answer

change_kind_matches_numbers.removed_positive: Line {line} is marked as removed scope but carries a positive quantity of {quantity} - an omission comes off the contract as a negative quantity
change_kind_matches_numbers.added_negative: Line {line} is marked as added scope but carries a negative quantity of {quantity} - scope that comes off the contract is removed, not added
change_kind_matches_numbers.removed_needs_contract_line: Line {line} is marked as removed scope but traces to no schedule-of-values line, so there is no contracted item for it to remove
change_kind_matches_numbers.modified_needs_contract_line: Line {line} is marked as modified scope but traces to no schedule-of-values line, so there is no contracted item for it to modify
change_kind_matches_numbers.suggestion: Correct the change kind or the quantity on the line's trace, or name the contract line the change affects

has_steps.fail: This case has no steps yet, so there is nothing for a reader to follow.
has_steps.suggestion: Add at least one step naming the screen to open and what to do there.

step_titled.fail: {count} step(s) are missing a title or a screen to open.
step_titled.suggestion: Give every step a short title and pick the screen it opens.

step_purpose.fail: {count} of {total} step(s) do not say why they matter, so the case reads as a list of clicks rather than an explanation.
step_purpose.suggestion: Add one line per step on what it is for; that is the part a new starter needs.

distinct_screens.fail: {count} step(s) open the same screen as the step before them, so the reader sees no change and cannot tell the steps apart.
distinct_screens.suggestion: Merge them into one step, or point the second at the screen the work actually moves to.

duration_plausible.fail: This case claims {minutes} minute(s) for {steps} step(s). A reader who cannot keep up stops trusting the rest of the estimate.
duration_plausible.suggestion: Raise the estimate to at least {minimum} minutes or drop some steps.

described.fail: This case has no summary, so the list shows a title and nothing else.
described.suggestion: Add one sentence on what the reader will have done by the end.

contract_form_declared.fail: The estimate does not name the contract form it is priced against
contract_form_declared.suggestion: Record the contract form. Preliminaries, risk and the payment terms are all priced differently under a different form, so the figure means little without it

payment_regime_declared.fail: The payment mechanism is incomplete: {missing} not recorded
payment_regime_declared.suggestion: Record both dates. A construction contract that fixes neither is not free of them; the Scheme for Construction Contracts supplies both, and the parties then find their payment terms in a statutory instrument rather than in what they signed

retention_declared.fail: The estimate does not say what retention applies
retention_declared.suggestion: Record the retention percentage and its release, or record that none applies. Retention is cash the contractor has earned and cannot draw, and an estimate silent about it is silent about working capital

cdm_duty_holders_declared.fail: CDM 2015 duty holders are not recorded: {missing} missing
cdm_duty_holders_declared.suggestion: Record the appointments. Where more than one contractor works on a project the client must appoint a principal designer and a principal contractor in writing, and if the client does not, the client holds those duties itself

hrb_regime_declared.fail: The higher-risk building question is unresolved: {reason}
hrb_regime_declared.unanswered: the estimate does not say whether this is a higher-risk building
hrb_regime_declared.disagrees: the estimate says higher-risk is {declared}, its own dimensions give {derived}
hrb_regime_declared.suggestion: A building is higher-risk when it is at least 18 m tall or has at least 7 storeys AND contains at least two residential units. Both halves count: a tall building with no dwellings is not higher-risk, and treating it as one buys a gateway programme nobody needed

vat_treatment_declared.fail: The estimate does not say how VAT is treated
vat_treatment_declared.suggestion: Record the treatment: the standard rate, a reduced or zero rate where the work qualifies, or the domestic reverse charge where the supply falls inside it. The reverse charge moves the VAT to the customer and changes what the contractor may invoice

country_set.fail: The project names no country, so no price base, tax rate or working calendar can be resolved for it
country_set.suggestion: Set the project's country in its settings. The country decides which regional pack, tax and calendar every figure is read against

currency_set.fail: The project states no currency, so its bills, markups and contracts cannot be summed
currency_set.suggestion: Choose the project currency in its settings. Every bill and contract is priced in it and every total is read in it

currency_matches_bill.fail: The project is priced in {project_currency}, but rows of this bill are priced in {bill_currencies}
currency_matches_bill.suggestion: Convert the rows to the project currency at a stated rate, or record the exchange rate on the project, so the bill total is one number

priced_bill_present.fail: The project has no bill of quantities with positions, so there is nothing to estimate from
priced_bill_present.suggestion: Create a bill of quantities and add positions, or import one from a CAD model, a spreadsheet or an exchange file

bill_base_date_set.fail: The bill "{bill}" does not state the base date its rates are current at
bill_base_date_set.suggestion: Record the base date on the bill. Without it the rates cannot be indexed, taxed at their own date or compared with another estimate

classification_standard_set.fail: The project has no classification standard, so its positions carry codes nobody can check
classification_standard_set.suggestion: Choose the classification standard the project is coded to. It also decides which country rule sets validation runs

planned_dates_set.both_missing: The project has neither a planned start nor a planned end date
planned_dates_set.start_missing: The project has a planned end date but no planned start date
planned_dates_set.end_missing: The project has a planned start date but no planned end date
planned_dates_set.unreadable: The planned date "{value}" cannot be read as a date
planned_dates_set.suggestion: Enter the planned start and end dates on the project as dates. Time-related cost, escalation and the programme are priced between them

planned_dates_ordered.fail: The project is planned to start on {start} and end on {end}, which is before it starts
planned_dates_ordered.suggestion: Swap or correct the planned dates so the start comes before the end

client_recorded.fail: The project records no client, and no contract names an employer
client_recorded.suggestion: Record the client on the project, or add the employer as a party on the contract, so the estimate has an addressee

procurement_started.fail: The project is in the {phase} phase, yet it has no contract and no tender package
procurement_started.suggestion: Create a tender package from the bill or record the contract, or set the phase back to the estimating stage the project is actually in

unit_rate_not_rederived.fail: Position {ordinal}: the resource rows cannot price the line, so the unit rate was not re-derived from them
unit_rate_not_rederived.fallback_allowance: Position {ordinal}: the resource rows are an estimated allowance split holding the position quantity, so the unit rate was not re-derived from them
unit_rate_not_rederived.assumed_norm: Position {ordinal}: the resource rows carry norms the catalogue never stated, so the unit rate was not re-derived from them
unit_rate_not_rederived.norm_collapsed: Position {ordinal}: the resource rows lost their catalogue norm and hold the position quantity instead, so the unit rate was not re-derived from them
unit_rate_not_rederived.whole_position_quantities: Position {ordinal}: the resource rows hold whole-position quantities instead of per-unit norms, so the unit rate was not re-derived from them
unit_rate_not_rederived.suggestion: Review the buildup - re-derive the position from its catalogue item through the resource norm review, or correct the rows by hand

knr_reference_required.fail: Position {ordinal} cites no KNR catalogue table
knr_reference_required.suggestion: Name the catalogue table the norms come from in the podstawa, for example KNR 2-02 0201-01, or write kalkulacja indywidualna for a line priced by own calculation

knr_reference_recognised.fail: Reference '{code}' on position {ordinal} names no KNR catalogue family
knr_reference_recognised.suggestion: Start the reference with its catalogue family, such as KNR, KNNR, KNR-W or KSNR, or mark the line as kalkulacja indywidualna

bim_rules.filter_not_object: Property conditions must name each property with the value it needs.
bim_rules.unknown_operator: The condition on "{prop}" uses a comparison this version does not know. Choose one from the list.
bim_rules.value_not_allowed: The condition on "{prop}" checks whether the property is empty and takes no value.
bim_rules.value_required: The condition on "{prop}" needs a value.
bim_rules.value_too_long: The value of the condition on "{prop}" is too long, 500 characters at most.
bim_rules.value_not_number: The condition on "{prop}" compares numbers, and "{value}" is not a number. Write a number, with a unit such as mm, m, m2, m3 or kg if you need one.
bim_rules.group_not_found: The saved group or Smart View this rule takes its elements from is not in this project. Choose another one or clear it.

bim_versions.parent_not_found: The model this upload should be a new version of is not in this project. Choose another one, or upload it as a separate model.
bim_versions.parent_not_ready: "{name}" has not finished importing, so it cannot take a new version yet. Wait until it is ready, or upload this one as a separate model.
bim_versions.parent_superseded: "{name}" already has a newer version, {version}. Upload this one as a new version of the newest one instead.

contract_without_schedule.fail: Contract {code} is worth {amount} but has no schedule lines, so its money is on no cost line.
contract_without_schedule.suggestion: Give the contract one account in cost control, or add its schedule lines.

contract_sum_differs.fail: Contract {code} is worth {total}, but its schedule lines add up to {lines} ({difference} apart).
contract_sum_differs.suggestion: Correct the contract value or the schedule lines so they agree.

change_without_agreed_amount.fail: Change order {code} is approved without an agreed amount.
change_without_agreed_amount.suggestion: Record the amount agreed with the contractor before the change is approved.

change_without_approval_date.fail: Change order {code} is approved without an approval date.
change_without_approval_date.suggestion: Record when the change was approved.

billed_before_approval.fail: {amount} is billed on contract {contract} for change {code}, which is {status}, not approved.
billed_before_approval.suggestion: Approve the change first, or take the billing back off the claim.

contract_over_target.fail: Contract {code} commits {committed}, {difference} above the {target} of the bill it was let from (more than {tolerance} %).
contract_over_target.suggestion: Check the award and its changes against the bill, and record why the work costs more.

account_over_plan.fail: Account {code} carries {committed} of commitments, {difference} above its plan of {planned} (more than {tolerance} %).
account_over_plan.suggestion: Check the commitments on this account, or update the plan with a reason.

quantity_overrun.fail: Line {code} of contract {contract} is measured at {measured} {unit} against {contracted} {unit} contracted, {over} % over (allowed {tolerance} %).
quantity_overrun.suggestion: Check the measurement, or agree the extra quantity as a change.

measurement_exceeds_commitment.fail: Contract {code} is measured at {measured}, {difference} above its value with approved changes of {committed}.
measurement_exceeds_commitment.suggestion: Approve the change that covers the extra work, or check the measurement.

invoice_without_contract.fail: Supplier invoice {number} for {amount} belongs to no contract or order.
invoice_without_contract.suggestion: Link its lines to a contract, or record it as a direct cost on one account.

cumulative_total_fell.fail: Invoice {number} on contract {contract} states {net} to date, less than the {previous} of invoice {previous_number} before it, although the contract is invoiced cumulatively.
cumulative_total_fell.suggestion: If the invoice bills only the new work, the contract is invoiced incrementally; if it reduces the total, enter it as a credit note.

invoice_after_final.fail: Invoice {number} on contract {contract} follows the final invoice {final}.
invoice_after_final.suggestion: Enter later work as day work or a credit note, or mark the right invoice as the final one.

claim_invoice_in_cumulative.fail: Invoice {number} on contract {contract} was raised from a claim and bills one period, but the contract is invoiced cumulatively.
claim_invoice_in_cumulative.suggestion: Use one way of invoicing per contract: switch the contract to incremental invoicing, or enter the contractor's cumulative invoices instead.

release_differs.fail: The release confirmed for invoice {number} on contract {contract} is {stored}, but the contract's terms give {computed} today.
release_differs.suggestion: Check what changed since the release (terms, invoice amounts, deductions), then reopen and confirm the release again.

rounding_out_of_range.fail: Invoice {number} is rounded by {rounding}, outside the agreed rounding step of {step}.
rounding_out_of_range.suggestion: Rounding only cuts a release down by less than one step; switch rounding on in the payment terms or reopen the release.

final_retention_without_warranty.fail: The final invoice {number} on contract {contract} holds {amount} retention, but no warranty retention is agreed.
final_retention_without_warranty.suggestion: Agree warranty retention in the payment terms, or reopen the release so all retention is paid with the final invoice.

posting_exceeds_held.fail: More retention was paid back on contract {contract} than it holds: {amount} too much.
posting_exceeds_held.suggestion: Void the retention posting that is too high and post the amount actually held.

posting_before_event.fail: {amount} retention on contract {contract} was paid back on {posted}, before its release event was due on {due}.
posting_before_event.suggestion: Check the date of the release event, or post the release once the event has happened.

posting_without_event_date.fail: {amount} retention on contract {contract} was paid back, but the date of its release event is not recorded.
posting_without_event_date.suggestion: Record the date the release event was reached, so the payment can be checked against it.

retention_still_held.fail: Contract {contract} is completed and still holds {amount} retention.
retention_still_held.suggestion: Release the retention at its event in the retention register, or keep it held for the warranty period.

discount_not_agreed.fail: The release of invoice {number} on contract {contract} takes an early payment discount of {amount}, but the contract allows none.
discount_not_agreed.suggestion: Switch the early payment discount on in the payment terms, or reopen the release without it.

discount_after_deadline.fail: A discount of {amount} was kept back on invoice {number}, but the payment on {paid_on} came after the discount date {until}.
discount_after_deadline.suggestion: Pay the discount amount as well, or record why the contractor accepted the late discount.

invoiced_over_measured.fail: Contract {contract} is invoiced at {invoiced}, {difference} above the {measured} measured (quantity times rate).
invoiced_over_measured.suggestion: Check the measurement before releasing more money, or hold the difference back on the next release.

invoiced_over_contract.fail: Contract {contract} is invoiced at {invoiced}, {difference} above its value of {value}, and nothing is measured on it.
invoiced_over_contract.suggestion: Record the measurement or the change order that covers the extra money before releasing more.

reverse_charge_with_vat.fail: Invoice {number} is reverse charged but carries {vat} VAT.
reverse_charge_with_vat.suggestion: A reverse charged invoice carries no VAT; correct the VAT amount or the VAT category of its lines.

line_without_vat_rate.fail: Invoice {number} carries VAT, but {count} of its lines state no VAT rate.
line_without_vat_rate.suggestion: Enter the VAT rate on every line so deductions and exports take the right tax.

duplicate_number.fail: Invoice number {number} from the same contractor is entered {count} times.
duplicate_number.suggestion: Cancel the copy, or correct the invoice number if these are different invoices.

possible_duplicate.fail: Invoice {number} has the same contractor, amount ({amount}) and date ({on}) as invoice {other}.
possible_duplicate.suggestion: Check that it is not the same invoice entered twice under another number.

certificate_missing.fail: Invoice {number} on contract {contract}: the payee holds no {certificate} valid on {on}, which {reference} requires before the payment is released.
certificate_missing.suggestion: Record the certificate on the payee's subcontractor record, or hold the payment until it is shown.

split_payment_annotation_missing.fail: Invoice {number} lists construction works or other split payment goods and exceeds {threshold}, but it does not carry the annotation "{annotation}".
split_payment_annotation_missing.suggestion: Ask the supplier for a corrected invoice with the annotation, and pay it by split payment in any case: the obligation to pay that way does not depend on the annotation.

split_payment_not_used.fail: Invoice {number} falls under split payment, but a payment of it was recorded with another method. The buyer becomes liable for an additional {sanction}, 30 percent of its VAT.
split_payment_not_used.suggestion: Pay such invoices from the VAT account by split payment, and record the method on the payment as split_payment.

split_payment_annex_unknown.fail: Invoice {number} exceeds {threshold}, and it is not recorded whether it lists goods or services of the split payment annex.
split_payment_annex_unknown.suggestion: Record on the invoice whether it lists annex goods or services (annex_15), or their codes (pkwiu_codes), so the payment method can be checked.

reduced_rate_above_area_limit.fail: Invoice {number} charges {rate} percent VAT on the whole price, but the dwelling has {area_m2} m2 of usable area and the reduced rate holds up to {limit_m2} m2 ({reference}).
reduced_rate_above_area_limit.suggestion: Charge the reduced rate on {reduced_share_percent} percent of the price and the standard rate on the rest.

reduced_rate_object_unknown.fail: Invoice {number} charges the reduced {rate} percent housing rate, but the project does not record which dwelling it is for or its usable area ({reference}).
reduced_rate_object_unknown.suggestion: Record the dwelling kind and usable area on the project (vat_housing) so the rate and its area limit can be checked.

reduced_rate_not_eligible.fail: Invoice {number} charges the reduced {rate} percent housing rate on {object}, which does not qualify for it ({reference}).
reduced_rate_not_eligible.suggestion: Charge the standard rate, or correct the dwelling recorded on the project.

domestic_reverse_charge_ended.fail: Invoice {number} reverse charges {count} line(s), but domestic reverse charge on construction services has ended in this country.
domestic_reverse_charge_ended.suggestion: Unless the supplier is established abroad, ask for an invoice with VAT; such invoices are paid by split payment.

payment_term_over_cap.fail: Contract {contract} agrees a payment term of {days} days, longer than the {cap} days the late payment statute allows between businesses.
payment_term_over_cap.suggestion: Shorten the term to {cap} days, or record why the longer term is expressly agreed and not grossly unfair to the subcontractor.

below_commitment.fail: {code}: the forecast of {forecast} is below the {owed} already committed or asked for in pending changes ({difference} lower), and nothing explains it.
below_commitment.suggestion: Attach the document behind the lower figure (a credit note, a settlement, minutes), or say on the line why its method gives less.

move_without_evidence.fail: {code}: the forecast moved from {previous} to {current} ({delta}) since the last frozen snapshot, above the project's threshold, and has no comment and evidence yet.
move_without_evidence.suggestion: Write why the figure moved and link the document or minutes behind it before the snapshot is frozen.

method_override_without_comment.fail: {code} is forecast by {method} instead of the project's {project_method}, and no comment says why.
method_override_without_comment.suggestion: Add a short comment on the line's method, or set the line back to the project's method.

embedding_rounding_gap.fail: The sale-rate export differs from the editor total by {gap}, more than the tolerance of {tolerance}
embedding_rounding_gap.suggestion: Review the rounding in the export preview, or raise the tolerance for this bill
